lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਏ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahat naanak sache siu preet laae chookai man abhimaanaa ||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, loving the True Lord, the mind's egotism and self-conceit is eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਸੁਣਤ ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਨਤ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kahat sunat sabhe sukh paavahi maanat paahi nidhaanaa ||4||4||
lines.translation: Those who speak and listen to the Lord's Name, all find peace. Those who believe in it, obtain the supreme treasure. ||4||4||
Bilaaval, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh preet jis no aape laae ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself attaches the Gurmukh to His Love;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit ghar bilaaval gur sabad suhaae ||
lines.translation: joyful melodies permeate his home, and he is embellished with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
The women come and sing the songs of joy.
Meeting with their Beloved, lasting peace is obtained. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau tin balihaarai jinh har ma(n)n vasaae ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to those, whose minds are filled with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan kau miliaa sukh paaeeai har gun gaavai sahaj subhaae ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the humble servant of the Lord, peace is obtained, and one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
They are always imbued with Your Joyful Love;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu aap vasai man aae ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, You Yourself come to dwell in their minds.
They obtain eternal glory.
The Gurmukhs are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||
The Gurmukhs are imbued with the love of the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vaasaa har gun gaae ||
lines.translation: They abide in the home of their own being, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
They are dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love; they look so beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ihu ra(n)g kade na utarai saach samaae ||3||
lines.translation: This dye never fades away; they are absorbed in the True Lord. ||3||
The Shabad deep within the nucleus of the self dispels the darkness of ignorance.
Meeting with my Friend, the True Guru, I have obtained spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo sach raate tin bahuR na pheraa ||
lines.translation: Those who are attuned to the True Lord, do not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam driRaae pooraa gur meraa ||4||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, my Perfect Guru implants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within. ||4||5||
Bilaaval, Third Mehl:
From the Perfect Guru, I have obtained glorious greatness.
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has spontaneously come to abide in my mind.
Through the Word of the Shabad, I have burnt away egotism and Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dar saachai gur te sobhaa paaee ||1||
lines.translation: Through the Guru, I have obtained honor in the Court of the True Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਦੀਸ ਸੇਵਉ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagadees sevau mai avar na kaajaa ||
lines.translation: I serve the Lord of the Universe; I have no other work to do.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin anad hovai man merai guramukh maagau teraa naam nivaajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Night and day, my mind is in ecstasy; as Gurmukh, I beg for the bliss-giving Naam. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kee parateet man te paaee ||
lines.translation: From the mind itself, mental faith is obtained.
Through the Guru, I have realized the Shabad.
How rare is that person, who looks upon life and death alike.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ਨਾ ਜਮੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bahuR na marai naa jam pekhai ||2||
lines.translation: She shall never die again, and shall not have to see the Messenger of Death. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਕੋਟ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar hee mahi sabh kot nidhaan ||
lines.translation: Within the home of the self are all the millions of treasures.
The True Guru has revealed them, and my egotistical pride is gone.
I keep my meditation always focused on the Cosmic Lord.
Night and day, I sing the One Name. ||3||
I have obtained glorious greatness in this age,
from the Perfect Guru, meditating on the Naam.
Wherever I look, I see the Lord permeating and pervading.
He is forever the Giver of peace; His worth cannot be estimated. ||4||
By perfect destiny, I have found the Perfect Guru.
He has revealed to me the treasure of the Naam, deep within the nucleus of my self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad at meethaa laaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is so very sweet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੬॥੪॥੬॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak trisan bujhee man tan sukh paaiaa ||5||6||4||6||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, my thirst is quenched, and my mind and body have found peace. ||5||6||4||6||10||
Raag Bilaaval, Fourth Mehl, Third House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਮ ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਰੇ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: udam mat prabh a(n)tarajaamee jiu prere tiu karanaa ||
lines.translation: Effort and intelligence come from God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; as He wills, they act.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਨਟੂਆ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਤੰਤੀ ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu natooaa ta(n)t vajaae ta(n)tee tiu vaajahi ja(n)t janaa ||1||
lines.translation: As the violinist plays upon the strings of the violin, so does the Lord play the living beings. ||1||
